0022600196.text: The Chicago Bulls (1-7, 14th in the East) host the Philadelphia 76ers (8-2, 1st in the East), with Chicago on a six-game losing streak and 0-2 at home, while Philadelphia has won eight of its last ten and is 4-1 on the road. Chicago is without Nic Claxton (out, hamstring strain) and Zach Collins (out, illness), and Jalen Smith (finger sprain) and Tobe Awaka (knee sprain) are day-to-day and game-time decisions. Philadelphia is missing Adem Bona (out, back sprain), Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery) and Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Joel Embiid (plantar fasciitis) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Bulls trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 series after losing 126-107 in Philadelphia on November 2, 2026, following a 2-1 Chicago edge in 2025-26.
